EnemyDefeatDispatch_CountKill: Per-enemy death processing (CallNear): sound #03, BCD and hex counter decrements, halt, death flash, kill flag, collision clear, optional field-reveal effect; returns with RestoreSavedPtr.
EnemyDefeatDispatch: Entry (X = defeated actor). Last enemy ($0AEC = 1): halt and JumpFar to StandardEnemyDefeatHandler. Otherwise run EnemyDefeatDispatch_CountKill, spawn field_reveal_object with the remaining count in $26, and Die.
EnemyDefeatDispatch_NotLast: Not the last enemy: per-enemy death processing, then the stat-gem reveal child, then Die.
loc_0AA4B8: Field-reveal bookkeeping: skip when deathActionIdx is 0 or its $0100-base event flag is already set; otherwise set it and spawn SpawnFieldRevealEffect with the index.
loc_0AA4E0: Return to the caller of the CallNear subroutine.
